thread.title: Miami Commissioners to discuss Bayfront Park Management Trust proposal

author: Miami Courant
title: Miami Commissioners to discuss Bayfront Park Management Trust proposal
text:
Mayor Francis Suarez, City Of Miami | City Of Miami website
Mayor Francis Suarez, City Of Miami | City Of Miami website
Two or more Commissioners from the City of Miami, along with their staff members, are expected to participate in a Sunshine Meeting. The meeting will focus on discussions related to City Commission agenda item SR.3 (file no. 17797). This item is set for the July 10, 2025, City Commission meeting and involves a proposal to abolish the Bayfront Park Management Trust.
The Sunshine Meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, July 8, 2025, at 7:00 P.M. It will be held at the Olympia Theater located at 174 E. Flagler Street, Miami, FL 33131. The venue is open to the public.
For further details about this meeting, individuals can contact 305-250-5333.
